The leading tool for querying and visualizing time series and metrics.

## What's Changed
* [loki] Apply loki.revisionHistoryLimit to the memcached StatefulSets by @DrFaust92 in https://github.com/grafana-community/helm-charts/pull/982
* [grafana-mcp] Update docker.io/grafana/mcp-grafana Docker tag to v2.3.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/grafana-community/helm-charts/pull/986
* [tempo-distributed] Update rollout-operator Docker tag to v0.54.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/grafana-community/helm-charts/pull/987
* [loki] Update loki dependency non-major updates by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/grafana-community/helm-charts/pull/985
* [loki] Add opt-in dataobj-builder component for Loki 4.0 by @LukoJy3D in https://github.com/grafana-community/helm-charts/pull/981
* [loki] Allow goMemLimitFactor and gogc of 0 to disable injection by @jlenos in https://github.com/grafana-community/helm-charts/pull/988
* [tempo-distributed] Switch gateway image to nginx/nginx-unprivileged by @matphilippe in https://github.com/grafana-community/helm-charts/pull/978
* [ci] Restore MinIO repositories and support new chart imports by @QuentinBisson in https://github.com/grafana-community/helm-charts/pull/994
* [CI] Update github-workflow dependency updates to v4.3.2 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/grafana-community/helm-charts/pull/995
* [loki] Update ghcr.io/jkroepke/access-log-exporter Docker tag to v1.0.2 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/grafana-community/helm-charts/pull/996
* [loki] Update loki dependency non-major updates to v3.7.10 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/grafana-community/helm-charts/pull/997
* [CI] Update github-workflow dependency updates by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/grafana-community/helm-charts/pull/1000
* [grafana] Fix VPA update mode documentation by @Artem-TSYH in https://github.com/grafana-community/helm-charts/pull/1002

## New Contributors
* @LukoJy3D made their first contribution in https://github.com/grafana-community/helm-charts/pull/981
* @jlenos made their first contribution in https://github.com/grafana-community/helm-charts/pull/988
* @Artem-TSYH made their first contribution in https://github.com/grafana-community/helm-charts/pull/1002

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/grafana-community/helm-charts/compare/grafana-14.4.1...grafana-14.4.2
